related.title: 艾達芙拉太陽能電廠
related.transfer: 可遷移「用地與功率密度」與「直交流比與削峰」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；艾達芙拉太陽能電廠的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Land use and power density" and "DC/AC ratio and clipping" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Al Dhafra Solar PV Plant must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦分期招標的單一業主園區：電價逐期下降、熔鹽塔的夜間供電與 2030 年目標；艾達芙拉太陽能電廠則以單一場址兩百萬瓩的光電廠：雙面模組的背面增益、模組數量與創紀錄的電價為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A single-buyer park tendered in phases: tariffs falling phase by phase, night supply from a salt tower and the 2030 target; Al Dhafra Solar PV Plant centres on A two-gigawatt plant at a single site: rear-side gain of bifacial modules, module count and a record tariff, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「年發電量與性能比」與「年發電量與性能比」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「各期電價的降幅」的模型移到艾達芙拉太陽能電廠，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「I–V 曲線與填充因子」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Annual yield and performance ratio" and "Annual yield and performance ratio".
Move the model of "The fall in tariff across phases" to Al Dhafra Solar PV Plant, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "I–V curve and fill factor", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「用地與功率密度」與「直交流比與削峰」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；艾達芙拉太陽能電廠的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Land use and power density" and "DC/AC ratio and clipping" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Al Dhafra Solar PV Plant must be respecified.

related.title: 諾爾瓦爾扎扎特太陽能複合園區
related.transfer: 可遷移「用地與功率密度」與「直交流比與削峰」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；諾爾瓦爾扎扎特太陽能複合園區的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Land use and power density" and "DC/AC ratio and clipping" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Noor Ouarzazate Solar Complex must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦分期招標的單一業主園區：電價逐期下降、熔鹽塔的夜間供電與 2030 年目標；諾爾瓦爾扎扎特太陽能複合園區則以槽式、塔式與光電合在一個園區：聚光比、儲熱電量與乾式冷卻為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A single-buyer park tendered in phases: tariffs falling phase by phase, night supply from a salt tower and the 2030 target; Noor Ouarzazate Solar Complex centres on trough, tower and photovoltaics in one complex: concentration ratio, stored energy and dry cooling, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「年發電量與性能比」與「鏡場面積與年發電量」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「各期電價的降幅」的模型移到諾爾瓦爾扎扎特太陽能複合園區，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「熱源溫度與循環效率」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Annual yield and performance ratio" and "Field aperture and annual energy".
Move the model of "The fall in tariff across phases" to Noor Ouarzazate Solar Complex, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Source temperature and cycle efficiency", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「用地與功率密度」與「直交流比與削峰」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；諾爾瓦爾扎扎特太陽能複合園區的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Land use and power density" and "DC/AC ratio and clipping" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Noor Ouarzazate Solar Complex must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 穆罕默德本拉希德太陽能園區
history.titleEn: Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum Solar Park
history.text: 2013 年第一期啟用；2017 年第二期 200 MW 啟用；2020 年第三期 800 MW 全部投運；2023 年第四期聚光太陽熱電廠啟用，第六期決標。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2013: The first phase opened. 2017: Phase II of 200 MW opened. 2020: Phase III of 800 MW was fully commissioned. 2023: The phase IV solar thermal plant opened and phase VI was awarded. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
